description: Measure HSV saturation, (max - min) / max, of subject pixels of a colour view: every 8th pixel whose luminance is above the luminance of the channel medians + 5 x (median |luminance - that| on a 32 px grid). Returns JSON: median, p90, p99, max, subject_pixel_count. A mono view is an error. luminance is 0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722B.
name: measure_saturation
